observations: Photo 0 shows a Bridgestone Dueler A/T tire sidewall.
The tire size is LT285/75R16, visible in photo 0.
A DOT code ending in (0317) is visible in photo 0, indicating manufacture in the 3rd week of 2017.
Photo 1 shows a stack of four tires with matching tread patterns.
Photo 2 is a close-up of the tread showing significant wear and visible cracking (dry rot) in the grooves.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a 2017 date code (7+ years old); Photo 2 shows dry rot and tread wear.

risks.risk: The tires are over 7 years old (DOT 0317), exceeding the 6-year safety recommendation for rubber integrity.
Visible dry rot in the tread grooves indicates the rubber is brittle and prone to failure.
Hidden internal damage or previous repairs (patches/plugs) on the inside liner.
risks.proof: Photos of the inside of the tires

proof_requests: Photos of the DOT codes on the other three tires to confirm they are the same age.
Clear photos of the inside of each tire to check for patches or structural damage.
response.reason: The brand, model, size, and age are clearly identified from the photos. The condition is visibly used with signs of aging, allowing for a valuation at the worst-case for aged, used tires.
